source.title: Call for Applicants - WMT Members (January 2023)
source.content:
The WCA Marketing Team is seeking new members! The application is open to everyone and we encourage those who do not have WCA positions to apply!

**What does the WCA Marketing Team do?**

The WMT is responsible for managing WCA relationships with external partners as well as working closely on the WCA Brand, including WCA merchandise, engagement, market research and working with WCA partners.

Here are some of the projects WMT is working on -

* Merchandising
 * You may have seen the launch of the [WCA Merchandise Store](https://shop.worldcubeassociation.org/) - WMT is seeking members who can help develop and grow the merchandising.
* Sponsorships 
 * WMT works with current WCA sponsors like Spin Master, and also works on exploring potential opportunities for the WCA (global and local scales). Candidates who have worked on getting sponsorships for competitions they have organized are strongly encouraged to apply.
* Championship Support
 * WMT is looking for members who can help market the continental and world championships - specifically in promoting the WCA brand and growing our reach.
* Gear team
 * WMT is responsible for fulfilling the gear orders made by delegates around the world. This is a good opportunity for someone with project management and communication experience.
 <!-- break -->

The application is open to everyone. Potential applicants do not have to hold a current position to be considered. 

**Requirements for Applicants**

* Interest and/or experience in Marketing the WCA Brand
* Approximate 5 - 10 Hours time commitment per week
* Creative mind, and the ability to work within a team
* Familiarity in dealing with merchandising/sponsorships/vendor management is a plus

Applicants should submit a PDF application including a brief personal introduction, their involvement with the WCA, their motivation for applying to the WMT, and any relevant experience or skills.

**Applications should be sent to sgrover@worldcubeassociation.org from now until February 20th, 2023, 23:59 UTC to be considered.**

translation.title: 招募 WCA 市场营销组成员（2023 年 1 月）
translation.content:
WCA 市场营销组正在招募新成员！所有人都可以申请，我们也鼓励尚未在 WCA 任职的人报名！

**WCA 市场营销组负责什么？**

WMT 负责管理 WCA 与外部伙伴的关系，同时参与 WCA 品牌相关工作，包括周边商品、公众参与、市场调研及合作伙伴事务。

以下是 WMT 正在开展的一些项目：

* 周边商品
  * 你可能已经看到上线的 [WCA 周边商店](https://shop.worldcubeassociation.org/)。WMT 正在寻找能够帮助开发和拓展周边商品的成员。
* 赞助
  * WMT 与 Spin Master 等现有 WCA 赞助商合作，也在全球和当地范围内寻找潜在合作机会。特别欢迎曾为自己主办的比赛争取赞助的人申请。
* 锦标赛支持
  * WMT 希望招募能够协助推广各大洲锦标赛和世锦赛的成员，重点是宣传 WCA 品牌、扩大影响范围。
* 器材小组
  * WMT 负责处理世界各地代表提交的器材订单。有项目管理和沟通经验的人可以在这方面发挥作用。

所有人都可以申请，不要求申请者目前已在 WCA 任职。

**申请条件**

* 对 WCA 品牌推广有兴趣或相关经验。
* 每周可投入约 5–10 小时。
* 有创意，能与团队合作。
* 熟悉周边商品、赞助或供应商管理者优先。

申请者须提交 PDF 格式的材料，包含简短的个人介绍、参与 WCA 的经历、申请加入 WMT 的原因，以及相关经验或技能。

**请于即日起至 2023 年 2 月 20 日 23:59 UTC，将申请发送至 sgrover@worldcubeassociation.org。**
